nodes.label: _apply_holds()
nodes.rationale: Holds min(disputed, balance); idempotency key HOLD:ack:account:amount reserved as PENDING first so a retry or racing worker never double-holds customer funds.

nodes.label: _bene_for_rrn()
nodes.rationale: CBDOC idempotency key includes defer_count so each morning retry re-queries CBDOC instead of reusing a cached empty result.

nodes.label: _cbdoc_wake_time()
nodes.rationale: CBDOC updates overnight (T+1), so recent NEFT/RTGS cases are retried next morning at CBDOC_RETRY_HOUR_IST.

nodes.label: _classify_rrn()
nodes.rationale: Only 22-char HSBCN/HSBCR tokens are UTRs; shorter ones are internal refs rejected to avoid duplicate legs. 12-digit tokens default to UPI, confirmed later by UPI API probe.

nodes.label: _find_txn_by_rrn()
nodes.rationale: Tolerant matching (case/whitespace-insensitive, delimited tokens, substring only for refs >=6 chars) to avoid false positives on short numbers.

nodes.label: _LEG_STATUS
nodes.rationale: IMPS/unresolved legs are real transfers we cannot look up, so they stay SUCCESS (00) with an ops remark rather than Invalid RRN (02).

nodes.label: _mha_money_transfer_to()
nodes.rationale: MHA rejects any unexpected field, so builders are the only place response objects are constructed with exact contract fields.

nodes.label: _normalise_bene()
nodes.rationale: UPI bankCode is not mapped because it repeats the IFSC and polluted payee_bank_code; keys deep-searched since decrypted payload nesting varies.

nodes.label: _reconcile_credit_from_dd()
nodes.rationale: Annotated as returning a 2-tuple but actually returns (objs, fully, cbdoc_pending); IMPS legs counted toward recovery since money did leave.

nodes.label: _run_state_machine()
nodes.rationale: Commits after each state step so retries resume where they left off; small (<=500) incidents split off so they cannot drag classification.

nodes.label: _send_mha_response()
nodes.rationale: Idempotent and non-fatal: send failures are recorded, not raised, so the complaint is not reprocessed on downstream hiccups.

nodes.label: _trace_and_collect()
nodes.rationale: Legacy CBDOC-based reconciliation; superseded by _reconcile_credit_from_dd and not called from the state machine.

nodes.label: Complaint Processing State Machine
nodes.rationale: RECEIVED->CLASSIFIED->ENRICHED->BALANCE_CHECKED->HOLD_APPLIED->RECONCILING->RESOLVED / NEEDS_REVIEW / AWAITING_CBDOC; persisted on sidecar so processing is resumable.

nodes.label: Idempotent Processing Steps Cache
nodes.rationale: Every upstream call cached in processing_steps under a UNIQUE idempotency_key so repeats never re-hit upstream or double-hold.

nodes.label: Hold-and-Trace Money Rule
nodes.rationale: B>=D hold D; B<D hold B then trace remaining R=D-B through debits until reconciled, else NEEDS_REVIEW.

nodes.label: Others <= 500 Small-Transaction Rule
nodes.rationale: Incidents at/below SMALL_TXN_THRESHOLD get txn_type_id 17 with no lookup/hold and ride along in the same response.

nodes.label: _bootstrap_processing_rows()
nodes.rationale: Sidecar table complaint_processing is owned by this service; shared complaints table is never written. INSERT...SELECT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING is race-safe.

nodes.label: claim_batch()
nodes.rationale: No queue: Cloud Scheduler polls; FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED plus a lease lets multiple instances claim disjoint batches safely.

nodes.label: Layer 0 Always Debit
nodes.rationale: Per MHA, layer 0 is always a debit from the HSBC account; layers 1-10 follow mode_of_payment.

nodes.label: Channel by RRN Shape
nodes.rationale: Channel decided by RRN/UTR shape (12 digits=UPI, 16/22 chars=IB) not sub_category, since an IB-categorised complaint can carry a UPI RRN; unknown shape triggers DD-enquiry probe.

nodes.label: Sidecar State Table Design
nodes.rationale: ComplaintProcessing keeps all processing state out of the shared complaints table; input categories stored as VARCHAR so vendor casing never rejected; generated columns marked Computed.

nodes.label: Account-centric CBDOC Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Anchor on fraud RRN, walk account debits chronologically accumulating until remaining R is reconciled; else NEEDS_REVIEW.

nodes.label: Failure Handling / MAX_ATTEMPTS
nodes.rationale: 'Never fail' means never lose a complaint, never double-act, always reach a terminal state.

nodes.label: Hold min(D, B) Rule
nodes.rationale: Hold the lesser of total disputed and balance; remainder R goes to CBDOC reconciliation.

nodes.label: Idempotent Hold (idempotency_key)
nodes.rationale: UNIQUE idempotency_key HOLD:<ack>:<account>:<amount> in processing_steps ensures a retry never double-holds a customer.

nodes.label: Polling Trigger (POST /process-batch)
nodes.rationale: At ~100 complaints/day a queue (Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks) is overkill; polling with SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and leases is simpler; expired leases are re-picked so no sweeper needed.

nodes.label: Schema Safety (read-only shared tables)
nodes.rationale: Service makes zero changes to shared tables complaints/instruments/incidents; all state lives in two owned tables so the other service's schema is untouched.

nodes.label: Resumable Processing State Machine
nodes.rationale: State committed after every step so crashes resume exactly where they left off; nothing reprocessed or lost.

nodes.label: UPI Debit Short-circuit
nodes.rationale: UPI+debit only needs beneficiary lookup, no hold; goes straight to RESOLVED.

nodes.label: Vendor Key Tolerance via AliasChoices
nodes.rationale: MHA JSON uses spaced/typo'd keys; canonicalise to snake_case accepting spaced variants so ingestion tolerates vendor formatting.

nodes.norm_label: python dependencies (fastapi, httpx, sqlalchemy, pg8000, pycryptodome, google-auth, secret-manager)

nodes.label: pg8000 TCP / Cloud SQL Unix Socket Connection
nodes.norm_label: pg8000 tcp / cloud sql unix socket connection
nodes.rationale: Plain host/user/password like DBeaver; on Cloud Run uses unix socket with password auth (no IAM connector); pool_pre_ping survives Cloud Run idle.

nodes.label: AES-256-CBC base64(iv+ciphertext) Format
nodes.rationale: MHA expects a single base64 string with the random 16-byte IV prepended to the ciphertext; key never hard-coded, comes from Secret Manager.

nodes.label: Secret Manager Startup Injection
nodes.rationale: Secrets fetched at startup into os.environ before settings are read so _env calls pick them up; no-op locally; existing env vars win; missing secret hard-fails rather than running half-configured.

nodes.label: Bank Code Resolution Strategy (IFSC > exact > alias > fuzzy)
nodes.norm_label: bank code resolution strategy (ifsc > exact > alias > fuzzy)
nodes.rationale: Strongest signal first; VPA handle deliberately not used (identifies PSP app, not bank); unresolved returns default '00' because a wrong bank code is worse than an absent one; fuzzy floor 0.86.

nodes.label: MHA Gateway Config (Cloud Run service)
nodes.rationale: Resolution order env var > .env > default; string secrets injected as env vars, file secrets written to /tmp tmpfs with 0600 perms; startup validation fails fast instead of 500-ing on first request.

nodes.label: local_setup.sql (fresh local Postgres base tables)
nodes.rationale: Transcribed from schema.txt; run first on a fresh local DB, then migrations.sql. Use libpq URL for psql, not pg8000 URL.

nodes.label: migration.sql (ALTER-only upgrade)
nodes.rationale: No tables dropped, no data lost; idempotent with IF [NOT] EXISTS guards. Back up and pause orchestrator first.

nodes.label: seed_tests.sql (10 labelled test complaints)
nodes.rationale: One complaint per code path with distinct ack/account numbers so mock gateway picks balance/trace behaviour; dates relative to NOW() so recent/old classification is correct.

nodes.label: idx_cp_poll poller index
nodes.rationale: Poller's hot query: non-terminal, lease-free, ready (next_attempt_at) rows.

nodes.label: orchestrator_tables.sql (orchestrator-owned tables)
nodes.rationale: Tables owned only by the orchestrator; zero changes to shared schema.txt tables so it is safe to run alongside the MHA ingest service.

nodes.label: schema.sql (full standalone schema, enum version)
nodes.rationale: Idempotent full schema; shared tables owned by MHA ingest service (orchestrator reads complaints/instruments/incidents, writes api_response_logs); orchestrator-owned tables keep processing state out of shared tables.

nodes.label: set_updated_at() trigger function
nodes.rationale: Keeps updated_at current on every UPDATE across all six tables.

nodes.label: seed.sql (simulated MHA complaint insert)
nodes.rationale: Simulates the other service inserting an MHA complaint; sets only business columns so orchestrator columns take defaults (processing_state='RECEIVED') as in prod.

nodes.label: schema.sql (updated, VARCHAR categories)
nodes.rationale: Input-facing categories are plain VARCHAR with no enum/CHECK so MHA can send any case; classifier uppercases in app layer. Only api_response_status stays an enum since this service writes it with fixed case.

nodes.label: acknowledgement_mha JSONB column
nodes.rationale: Decrypted acknowledgement returned by MHA for each job.

nodes.norm_label: optional drop of unused enum types
nodes.rationale: Run only after BOTH services deploy VARCHAR-based models, otherwise the other service errors on missing type.

nodes.label: Enum -> VARCHAR conversion
nodes.rationale: Accept any case/value from MHA with no DB-level rejection; shared tables so coordinate with MHA ingest service.

nodes.label: idempotency_key unique column (double-hold guard)
nodes.rationale: UNIQUE idempotency_key on processing_steps prevents applying a hold twice.

nodes.label: CBDOC T+1 Defer Policy
nodes.rationale: CBDOC is T+1 so recent frauds aren't in it yet; reconciliation was deferred by CBDOC_BUFFER_HOURS (28) up to MAX_CBDOC_DEFERS; now credit reconciliation sources debits from live DD enquiry so CBDOC_DEFER_RECENT defaults false.

nodes.label: OIDC Service-to-service Auth
nodes.rationale: Standard way one Cloud Run service calls another private one; token minted for GATEWAY_AUDIENCE, imported lazily so local runs need no GCP creds.

nodes.label: Sensitive-data Tokenisation (X-HSBC-Sensitive-Data)
nodes.rationale: Gateway expects an opaque token in the query param and the real account in a sensitiveData body [{key,value}] so account numbers stay out of URLs.

nodes.label: Account-derived Mock Behaviour
nodes.rationale: Behaviour derived from account number so one mock + one seed exercises every path; availableBalance intentionally 0 to expose bugs reading it instead of currentBalance.
